name: Eternal Autumn
source:
You need help from someone special like Yuna. Luckily, she and her girlfriend Shiori agree to lend a hand. Together, using your power as an android, nicknamed Alison, you travel to other dimensions to find your creator. What will happen?

[From [url=https://leafletgames.itch.io/eternal-autumn]Itch.io[/url]]
